editionLabel: The City of Kings English rulebook
firstPlayerRule: Choose a starting player; the rulebook recommends that the bravest player go first.
clarifications: The bravest-player criterion is a recommendation, not a required method.
The chosen starting player takes the first turn, then turns proceed clockwise.
